feed.title: Get ready, Apple’s iPhone event is massive this year
feed.summary: Apple's upcoming September 9th event, "Surprise and Shine," is anticipated to be one of its biggest in years, featuring a new CEO, John Ternus, taking the stage for the first time. The event is expected to unveil a revolutionary folding iPhone Ultra, updated iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models, and new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4. Apple is also poised to introduce updated Apple TV and HomePod mini devices, leveraging a new Siri architecture, with a potential preview of the long-rumored HomePad smart hub.
